scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c teal,blue "npm run dev -w @consultancy/web" "npm run dev -w @consultancy/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @consultancy/shared && npm run build -w @consultancy/api && npm run build -w @consultancy/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c teal,blue "npm run start -w @consultancy/web" "npm run start -w @consultancy/api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @consultancy/web --if-present && npm run lint -w @consultancy/api --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @consultancy/api --if-present && npm run test -w @consultancy/web --if-present
